inputs.escalation_reason: Customer asked for a human after a repeated delivery complaint

steps.action: Arm the adapter to accept then hang
steps.expected: Orchestrator.HandoffBus accepts the request and never responds; the engine deadline is 1000 ms

steps.action: Observe the abort and the failure classification
steps.expected: HandoffBus unavailable / hangs past 1000ms -> QUEUE_DOWN; the mutex release and the handoff commit together or not at all, so the session is never left half-released and the customer receives an honest 'waiting for a human' status, never a false resolution

steps.action: Reconcile the unconfirmed effect by effect_key
steps.expected: reconciliation queries the provider for the effect_key before any retry and resolves presence/absence exactly once; the reservation moves RESERVED -> COMMITTED or RELEASED once
the replay returns the committed receipt, or performs the single authorised effect if reconciliation proved absence; the provider effect count stays 1
no success execution_status and no receipt exists without provider evidence; the customer-visible state is derived from the receipt, not the request

assertions: exactly one external effect exists for the effect_key after timeout + reconcile + replay (kpi:Duplicate Execution stays 0, kpi:Failed Execution records the unconfirmed attempt)
the run records error.code='DISPATCH_TIMEOUT' with error.outcome='UNKNOWN' and never stores success for the aborted attempt (NFR-008)
retry_on_timeout=false is honoured: max_retries=2 applies only to non-timeout failures and no blind re-dispatch happens
the reconciliation outcome is written to the audit trail with the effect_key, so a later operator can explain the gap
forbidden: recording success without a provider receipt
evidence: per-attempt execution log: attempt number, latency, classification, adapter outcome (Orchestrator.HandoffBus)
effect_reservations row (effect-bearing skills) or adapter invocation log (effect-free skills) with the case effect_key/idempotency key
audit entry recording the timeout/deadline breach and the reconciliation result
